patches.name: Custom font
patches.description: Answers every resolver TikTok gets one of its own faces from - the native factory, the Compose loader, the asset loader Lynx reads and the WebView interceptor hybrid pages are fed through - so an imported font file replaces TikTok's own text on every surface. The switch and the picker are in Tweaks; off by default, and inert until a font is imported.
